Summaries.eng: A saga begins... Photon, a young man with a kind heart and superhuman strength, leaves his village on Sandy Planet (a desert world) in search of a runaway friend. During this heroic quest, he is accidentally engaged to a renegade space pilot! Now they're on the run from the evil emperor of the galaxy and his bumbling henchmen. But even worse than the incompetent bad guys are the disastrous cooking contests, exploding spas and cheerleading aliens!
Summaries.jpn: 遠い過去か未来もわからぬ時代、主人公フォトンは、亜法という不思議なエネルギーが満ちた砂漠の惑星に住んでいた。 ある日、彼の住む村の村長の孫娘アウンが村の宝を持ったまま、ひとめぼれした相手を追いかけてしまうという事態が発生する。 村長の依頼を受けたフォトンは彼女を追いかけるが、そこで謎の少女キーネと出会い、誤解によって夫婦の契りを結んでしまう。 キーネの協力もあって、アウンに追いつき、宝を返してもらうことはできた。 だが、アウンは村へ帰ることを拒絶し、フォトンを宝の谷へ落してしまう。 宝の谷でフォトンが目にしたのは、700年前にキーネが乗っていた宇宙船だった。

Summaries.eng: Keyne Acqua is a renegade being chased by the evil Papachurino, crash landing onto Earth. In the same planet, Photon is asked to bring back Aun, who's out chasing after her dream boy "Laman" yet again. Though during his pursuit, Photon found himself in a mysterious spaceship with a woman lying naked in the middle of it.
Aun found out the hard way that she isn't the only girl alive in Laman's world. She makes an unusual encounter with Papachurino, and work together to find Photon and Keyne.

Photon wakes up with an angry stomach. Keyne and Aun compete with each other to bake Photon their best meals in order to outclass one another, but sir Papacha always manages to spoil the food. Though does he know yet that Princess Lashara is coming to Sandy Planet too?

Papacha decided to party it out in an Inn, but refused to pay and is now working his way to cover the fees. Aun, Photon, Pochi #1, and Keyne, decide to pay a visit to that very same Inn. Lashara also stops by.

Keyne seems to have finally found the answer to her long journey on earth after discovering the devil's hot spring. Though little did she know that Sir Papacha had already arrived in the same destination.

Faces are revealed, families ties are being exploited, and it seems The Galactic Emporer has won, though it's Photon who foils his plans. However, Sir Papacha comes out of nowhere with Gene's Genie, ready to visit the Anti Aho furnace.
